# VSCODE Studio

Customize and change all the color schemes required by VS Code.

[![Enter To Use](https://img.shields.io/badge/VSCode_Studio-Design_Now-blue?style=plastic)](https://ifekri.github.io/vscode-studio) ![](https://img.shields.io/badge/Github_Page-grey?logo=github&style=plastic)

With this tool, you can color code your VS Code as you wish, and after you're done, you can apply the changes by copying the resulting source code to the VS Code `settings.json`.
